name: Two-step break
desc: Classic 2-step drum & bass: 909 kick on the one and the skip, snare on the backbeat, ghost-dynamic hats sweeping over 32 cycles, an open-hat euclid rotation, and a chopped uzu 'brk' loop laced through the top. Reverse/double-time fills bloom every 8 bars.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~ ~ bd ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}), s("~ ~ sd ~ ~ [~ sd] sd ~").bank("RolandTR909").room(.2).gain(${gain}*.88), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain("[.4 .16 .28 .12]*4").pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(4)).lpf(sine.range(${hatcut}*.6, ${hatcut}).slow(32)), s("~ ~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.4).cut(1), s("brk").loopAt(1).chop(8).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}*.5).lpf(sine.range(${hatcut}*.15, ${hatcut}*.45).slow(24))).every(8, x=>x.fast(2)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ [~ bd] [bd ~]").bank("RolandTR909").shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}), s("~ ~ sd ~ ~ [~ sd] [sd sd] [sd ~]").bank("RolandTR909").room(.18).gain(${gain}*.88).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain("[.42 .18 .3 .14]*4").pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(3)).lpf(sine.range(${hatcut}*.7, ${hatcut}*1.2).slow(16)), s("oh(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.38).cut(1), s("brk").loopAt(1).chop(16).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}*.55).lpf(sine.range(${hatcut}*.2, ${hatcut}*.6).slow(8)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2))).every(8, x=>x.fast(2)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
